# Literal underscore text controls

Original WordprocessingML generated by `tools/underscore_text_fixture.py`.
Twelve runs cover Trebuchet MS/Arial, 12/16/28 pt and zero/one-twip character
spacing. The reference application exported the unchanged source as one page.
No font files or corpus content are included beyond the native reference PDF.

This isolates the apparent underscore interruptions seen in corpus #364.
At 96 DPI both native-PDF and browser rasters retain dark coverage in every
sampled interior column. Tonal edge modulation differs, but a continuity defect
is not established. Do not replace literal underscore glyphs with a solid rule.
The source text, character spacing and glyphs remain authoritative.

Relevant OOXML: ECMA-376 Part 1 §§17.3.2.26 (rFonts), 17.3.2.38 (sz),
17.3.2.35 (spacing), 17.3.3.31 (t). No reference/spec divergence is claimed.
`reference.json` records method, limits, source/reference hashes and samples.
Private browser images and successful editing exports remain in review scratch.

Reproduce with `python tools/compare_underscore_text.py <96-DPI-app-page.png>`.
The comparator rejects a missing case or mismatched full-page dimensions.
Source plus no-edit/edited/undo exports pass four XML schema checks.
